name: Cobblestone lissencephaly without muscular or ocular involvement

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for cobblestone lissencephaly without muscular or ocular involvement

criteria.description: MRI demonstrating characteristic cobblestone lissencephaly with cortical malformation and absence of muscular or ocular abnormalities
Presence of developmental delay and hypotonia without muscular dystrophy or ocular defects
No clinical or laboratory evidence of muscular dystrophy or ocular abnormalities
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with cobblestone lissencephaly spectrum without muscular or ocular phenotype

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of neuroradiologic evidence plus clinical neurological features without muscular or ocular involvement
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of muscular dystrophy and ocular abnormalities to differentiate from related syndromes.

laboratory: Normal creatine kinase levels (absence of muscular dystrophy)
imaging: MRI showing cobblestone lissencephaly with thickened cortex and irregular cortical surface
Absence of ocular structural abnormalities on imaging

distinguishingFeatures: Ocular abnormalities such as retinal dysplasia
Ocular malformations including cataracts and retinal detachment

redFlags: Progressive muscle weakness or elevated creatine kinase
Ocular abnormalities such as retinal detachment or cataracts
Rapid neurological deterioration or refractory seizures
references: Dobyns WB et al. Cobblestone lissencephaly: clinical and genetic aspects. Am J Med Genet A. 2019.
Orphanet Report Series: Cobblestone lissencephaly without muscular or ocular involvement. Orphanet. 2023.
Poretti A et al. MRI features of cobblestone lissencephaly. Neuropediatrics. 2021.
